headline: Info Edge posts 93% fall in Q2 net profit due to base effect, declares Rs 3 dividend
hook: Base effect drives large profit drop
summary: Info Edge reported a net profit of Rs 334 crore for the second quarter, marking a 93% decline year-on-year due to a high base from an exceptional gain in the previous year. Revenue from operations rose 13% with healthy growth across recruitment, 99acres, and matchmaking verticals. Operating profit also saw an uptick alongside ongoing AI-led business expansion. The board declared an interim dividend of Rs 3 per share.
why_it_matters: Headline profit drop masks steady core revenue growth for shareholders.
winners_losers: Info Edge shareholders gain on dividend

headline: Sanjeev Bikhchandani to lead Info Edge as CEO from late 2026
hook: Leadership change at a top Indian internet firm

headline: Info Edge appoints Sanjeev Bikhchandani as Group CEO while Hitesh Oberoi transitions to non-executive role
summary: Info Edge (India) Limited has announced a major leadership transition within its top management. Mr. Hitesh Oberoi is moving from his role as Managing Director and CEO to an Additional Director in a non-executive capacity. Simultaneously, co-founder Mr. Sanjeev Bikhchandani has been appointed as Executive Vice Chairman, MD, and Group CEO.
